name: generative-ui
description: Generative UI: the assistant shows you a designed interface (a trip plan, a comparison, a checklist, a schedule, a summary with numbers) instead of a wall of text. A closed palette of blocks, drawn in your theme, with buttons that answer back.

ai.insodimension.dimension.title: Generative UI

tools.name: render_ui
tools.description: Show the user a designed interface (plan, comparison, checklist, schedule, numbers) built from a fixed palette of blocks.

examples: Plan three days in Lisbon for me
Compare these two laptops side by side
Make me a packing checklist for a week of hiking
